scope: Curated comparison, not exhaustive recommendations or executable offers. Ordinary domestic callable retail deposits below INR 30000000 only.
freshness_policy: Seven days is an application review policy, not a bank promise that rates remain valid. Recheck live booking rate and terms before opening.
tax_basis: Quoted annual card rates are gross before tax, not after-tax or effective annual yields; monthly payout may be discounted.
renewal_policy: No future renewal rate is supplied. Each FD is a one-time lump-sum contract, not a monthly instalment plan.
insurance_note: DICGC maximum INR 500000 includes principal plus interest across eligible accounts at one bank in the same right and capacity; do not infer remaining cover without all account facts.

products.product_name: Ordinary callable domestic retail fixed deposit
products.withdrawal_note: The August 2024 booklet describes a 0.50 percentage-point early-closure penalty up to INR 500000 and 1 point above that but below INR 20000000, applied to the lower relevant actual-period or contract rate. Terms for INR 2-to-3 crore are not established here; confirm current booking terms.
products.eligibility_note: Resident individual; senior rate requires age 60 or above at booking and verified eligibility. No staff, super-senior or special-offer premium assumed. Senior must be the primary holder; the cited booklet requires at least INR 10000 for the additional senior rate.
products.compounding_note: Gross annual card rate; payout choice, actual day count, reinvestment and tax affect proceeds. No exact maturity amount or after-tax yield promised.
